newsitem.title: USA: Middleby to sell refrigeration division.
newsitem.headline: Middleby to sell refrigeration division.

text.p: Middleby Corp, which makes and markets equipment used for cooking in restaurants, said on Friday that it agreed to sell its Victory Refrigeration Co subsidiary to an investor group led by local management.
Terms of the letter of intent were not disclosed.
Victory Refrigeration was acquired in 1989 as part of Middleby's purchase of a foodservice equipment group. Based in Cherry Hill, N.J., it makes refrigeration equipment for commercial customers.

Middleby said the sale will allow the company to refocus its resources toward growing its core cooking and warming equipment divisions and expanding its international operations. Proceeds from the sale will be used to reduce debt, Middleby said in a statement.
Closing of the proposed transaction requires completion of financing arrangements by the investor group and reaching a definitive agreement, it said.
Shares of Middleby closed off 3/8 to 5-5/8.
